data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross opening claims reserves at 1 January 2017 were GBP 210.466m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse movement on prior underwriting years (<=2015) of c. GBP 12.8m (gross), driven by adverse development in parts of the 2014 and 2015 years partially offset by favourable development in earlier years. The published narrative reports a small net release after reinsurance of GBP 0.8m, showing that reinsurance recoveries materially offset the gross deterioration. Movement drivers cited include favourable development in Property, Marine and Credit & Political Risk, offset by strengthening in Liability (including Financial Institutions claims following the FCA annuity review) and Accident & Health.
raw_causal_phrases: Overall on an aggregate basis, reserve releases of GBP 0.8m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2017.
We strengthened reserves for two specific large claims on the Financial Institutions part of our Liability account during 2017 following the market wide FCA review into annuity sales.
We had a reserve release on our Credit and Political Risk account following favourable development in the year.
Across all classes combined we had a net reserve release of GBP 0.8m.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) gross figure was calculated from the published GROSS claims development triangle (Note 18). The syndicate narrative reports a net release of GBP 0.8m (after reinsurance). The gross triangle-derived PYD is +GBP 12.802m (strengthening) while the reported NET movement is a -GBP 0.8m release - indicating significant reinsurance offset. Gross PYD was computed excluding 2016 and 2017 per the instructed methodology. Where the report gives only net prior-year movements in prose, gross amounts were not provided; triangle was used as the authoritative gross source. Some small premium items (e.g. Aviation negative premium) appear as printed negative amounts in the segmental table.
